initial_findings.message: Service account token automounted: set automountServiceAccountToken: false unless the API is needed
May run as root (runAsNonRoot not true or runAsUser 0)
No NetworkPolicy in this manifest bundle: consider a default-deny NetworkPolicy

validators_initial.name: kube-linter
issues: host-pid: DaemonSet/log-collector: object shares the host's process namespace (via hostPID=true).
no-read-only-root-fs: DaemonSet/log-collector: container "collector" does not have a read-only root file system
privilege-escalation-container: DaemonSet/log-collector: container "collector" is Privileged hence allows privilege escalation.
run-as-non-root: DaemonSet/log-collector: container "collector" is not set to runAsNonRoot
sensitive-host-mounts: DaemonSet/log-collector: host system directory "/" is mounted on container "collector"
unset-cpu-requirements: DaemonSet/log-collector: container "collector" has cpu request 0
unset-memory-requirements: DaemonSet/log-collector: container "collector" has memory limit 0
writable-host-mount: DaemonSet/log-collector: container collector mounts path / on the host as writable

attempts.rationale: Removed privileged, hostPID, hostPath replaced with emptyDir, set automountServiceAccountToken false, added runAsNonRoot, non-zero runAsUser, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem true, dropped all capabilities, added CPU/Memory limits and requests.
attempts.proposed_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: log-collector
  namespace: observability
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: log-collector
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: log-collector
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: collector
          image: fluent/fluent-bit:3.1.9
          securityContext:
            privileged: false
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: host-root
              mountPath: /host
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "128Mi"
      volumes:
        - name: host-root
          emptyDir: {}

findings.message: No NetworkPolicy in this manifest bundle: consider a default-deny NetworkPolicy

drifts.detail: hostPath volume 'host-root' (/) was replaced by emptyDir: the workload no longer sees the host files it was mounted to read or write
hostPID was turned off: the workload no longer sees host processes/IPC
service account token is no longer mounted: breaks the app if it calls the Kubernetes API
privileged mode was removed: anything needing device or kernel access will fail
now runs as non-root (runAsUser 1000): the image must support that user
resource limits added: too-low values cause OOMKills or CPU throttling

intent.note: A security-clean patch changed what the workload does. Review before proposing.
